title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README to understand exo's purpose: connecting all your devices into an AI cluster to run frontier models locally with MLX, automatic device discovery, and RDMA-over-Thunderbolt support.

title: Application Entry Point
description: The Node entry point bootstraps all cluster components — Router, Worker, Master, Election, and API — in a single process. main.py wires them together via dependency injection.

title: Shared Foundation: Events & State
description: exo uses event sourcing for cluster state. The typed event/command/state models in shared/types define the immutable contracts, while apply() is the pure function that folds events into new state.

title: Messaging & Routing
description: The routing layer (zenoh pub/sub) is the backbone of inter-node communication. topics.py defines typed topics (GLOBAL_EVENTS, LOCAL_EVENTS, COMMANDS, ELECTION_MESSAGES), while the event router and router manage the pub/sub plumbing.

title: Master: Coordination & Placement
description: The master coordinates cluster state, indexes events, and places model instances across nodes. placement_utils.py and placement.py implement topology-aware auto-parallel placement decisions.

title: Worker: MLX Inference Engine
description: Workers handle inference tasks and manage runner processes. The MLX engine drives tensor-parallel generation, with the runner supervising model processes and the coordinator orchestrating downloads.

title: Model Download & Management
description: The download coordinator fetches model weights from HuggingFace with rate-limit handling and directory management, ensuring models are available before inference starts.

title: API Layer: OpenAI-Compatible Server
description: FastAPI server exposing OpenAI Chat Completions, Claude Messages, Responses, and Ollama-compatible APIs. Adapters translate between API request shapes and internal text-generation types.

title: Dashboard: Svelte Frontend
description: The Svelte 5 + TypeScript dashboard provides cluster management and chat UI. The main route and layout mount the app, with lib/components holding chat and model-selection components.

title: Rust Networking Core
description: Rust provides high-performance zenoh networking (gossipsub, peer discovery) exposed to Python via PyO3 bindings in exo_rs, plus system-level operations like pidfile management.

title: Testing & Integration
description: The test suite spans integration tests (1, 2, and 4-node clusters), dashboard tests, and resilience tests, built on the shared test framework and conftest fixtures.
